snowglobe.message.entered: You're inside! Build anything you like. To leave, right-click the glass wall with an empty hand.
snowglobe.message.nested: You can't open a globe from inside another one.
snowglobe.import.too_big: %s is %s blocks: too big even for the largest globe (%s).
snowglobe.import.no_globe: Look at a globe, or stand inside one, to import into it.
snowglobe.import.no_player: Only a player can import into a globe.
snowglobe.size.would_lose: Shrinking to %s would cut off %s blocks. Clear them out first (in creative, add 'force' to cut them anyway).
snowglobe.import.not_empty: This globe isn't empty. Clear it out first; importing never throws your blocks away.
snowglobe.import.missing: Not enough materials to build %s. Still needed: %s.
snowglobe.tooltip.snow_globe: A winter you can hold. Shake it to turn the seasons.
snowglobe.tooltip.terrarium: A garden under glass, for things that like it damp.
snowglobe.tooltip.storm_globe: Weather in a bottle. Hold it at arm's length.
snowglobe.tooltip.aquarium: A tank for a world that's mostly water.
snowglobe.tooltip.star_globe: It's always night in here, and the sky is never empty.
snowglobe.tooltip.nether_jar: Keep the lid on. Warm to the touch.
snowglobe.tooltip.shift: Hold Shift for how to use it
snowglobe.tooltip.how.turn: Right-click the base: turn it (and the time of day inside)
snowglobe.tooltip.how.knock: Punch the glass: knock, for anyone inside
snowglobe.tooltip.how.more: A fish bucket lets fish in; a water bucket catches one. A note block adds a music box.
snowglobe.config.lightning_rarity.toolti: One in this many chances strikes, in storm globes. 0 turns lightning off.
snowglobe.config.weather_inside.tooltip: How much rain, snow, sand or ash falls around you inside a globe.
snowglobe.config.thunder_outside.tooltip: Hear a storm globe's tiny thunder when you stand near it.
snowglobe.config.music_boxes.tooltip: Whether music boxes play their tune when wound.
